description: FULL BODY. A male Malaysian police officer in his late 30s. He has a neat, short haircut and a clean-shaven face. He is wearing a dark blue Royal Malaysia Police uniform with a silver badge and name tag on the chest, matching tactical trousers, and black leather boots. He stands with a professional and authoritative posture.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian woman in her early 60s of Chinese descent. She has short, salt-and-pepper hair styled in a simple bob. She wears a modest floral print blouse with long sleeves, loose-fitting dark gray trousers, and simple black slip-on shoes. She has a worried and weary expression, representing a retired clerk.

FULL BODY. An anonymous, featureless human figure represented as a dark, shadowy silhouette. The figure wears a sharp, high-collar digital cloak that glows with faint, flickering binary code patterns. One hand is slightly raised, glowing with a cold, artificial light to represent digital deception.
